hero_subtitle: The Optics Group studies light-matter and quantum systems: from liquid crystals and polarimetric imaging to ultracold atoms and topological photonics.

research_lines.title: Imaging
research_lines.description: Polarimetric, holographic and microscopy imaging, diffractive optics with liquid-crystal displays, and optical metrology, with applications in biomedicine and plant science.

research_lines.title: Polarimetry
research_lines.description: Mueller and Stokes polarimeters, depolarization metrics and polarization devices: from calibration and design to the classification of biological samples.

research_lines.title: Simulations
research_lines.description: Quantum simulation of gauge theories and many-body physics with ultracold atoms and Rydberg arrays, topological phases in lattices and photonic simulators, and quantum algorithms.

research_lines.title: Quantum optics & photonics
research_lines.description: Adiabatic passage and atomic coherence, supersymmetric and topological photonic waveguides, quantum structured light, high-dimensional quantum communication and quantum sensing.
